# StaticClosureCanBeUsed

<Badge type="info" text="info" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> <Badge type="info" text="PHP ≥ 5.4" />

Group: [Code style](/rules/#code-style) · PhpStorm name: `StaticClosureCanBeUsedInspection`

A closure (or arrow function) that never touches the object it was created in
can be declared `static`. That prevents an implicit `$this` binding, makes the
scope explicit and avoids keeping the surrounding object alive.

## Example

```php{11,13,15,17,22,31,46}
<?php
abstract class Base {
    public function work() {}
    public static function tool() {}
}

final class Runner extends Base {
    private $limit = 3;

    public function cases() {
        $squares = array_map(function ($n) { return $n * $n; }, [1, 2]);
        $capped  = array_map(function ($n) { return min($n, $this->limit); }, [4]);
        $helper  = array_map(function ($n) { return parent::tool(); }, [5]);
        $inst    = array_map(function ($n) { return parent::work(); }, [6]);
        $noop    = array_map(function () { ; }, []);
        $empty   = array_map(function () {}, []);
        $twice   = array_map(fn ($n) => $n * 2, [7]);
        $self    = array_map(fn ($n) => $n + $this->limit, [8]);
    }

    public function rebinding() {
        $detached = function () { return 42; };
        $copy = Closure::bind($detached, null, self::class);
        $other = $detached->bindTo(null);

        $attached = function () { return 7; };
        $attached->bindTo($this);
    }

    public function dispatching($queue) {
        $job = function () { return 'ok'; };
        Registry::push($job);

        $task = function () { return 'later'; };
        $queue->push($task);

        new Worker(function () { return 1; });
    }

    public function scopedMap() {
        return ['a' => function () { return 1; }];
    }
}

$routes = [
    'home' => function () { return 'index'; },
    'about' => static function () { return 'about'; },
];
$plain = [function () { return 0; }];
```

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 11: Closure does not use $this; declare it static.</li>
<li>line 13: Closure does not use $this; declare it static.</li>
<li>line 15: Closure does not use $this; declare it static.</li>

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Effect |
|---|---|---|---|
| SUGGEST_FOR_SHORT_FUNCTIONS | bool | true | When false, arrow functions are never reported. |

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "StaticClosureCanBeUsed": {
      "enabled": false,
      "options": {
        "SUGGEST_FOR_SHORT_FUNCTIONS": true
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore StaticClosureCanBeUsed

/**
 * @noinspection StaticClosureCanBeUsedInspection
 */
```
